payload.title: Upgrading the payout ledger
payload.summary: A coding agent moves the payout consumer from the old list endpoint to the windowed export. The first two attempts fail their checks. The third passes, and the lesson is written.
payload.notes: Assembled from recorded change facts, the recorded Clef answer, and the benchmark workspaces. Run timings and log excerpts are illustrative.

payload.title: The lesson that came before
payload.summary: An earlier payout upgrade left the lesson this session recalls.
payload.notes: Illustrative. The lesson text is the rule the product records.

payload.title: Pagination changed
payload.summary: The export returns a window with a cursor and a drained flag. The cursor is still present on the last page.

payload.title: The payout operation moved
payload.summary: The list endpoint moved from the old path to the export path.

payload.title: The operation ID changed
payload.summary: The operation ID changed from listPayouts to exportPayouts.

payload.title: Two query arguments were added
payload.summary: The export accepts a cursor and a limit. Both are optional.

payload.note: The consumer uses the path, not the operation ID.
